mentions.name: Your Pods (yourpods.app)
mentions.description: An open-source podcast player offering a premium listening experience with no ads, no tracking, and no subscription required. It supports iOS, CarPlay, and watchOS, and includes Podcast 2.0 features.
mentions.source_excerpt: A premium podcast listening experience… with no ads, no tracking, and no subscription required. Full support for iOS/CarPlay/WatchOS including Podcast 2.0 features.  Open source: https://yourpods.app/
